content: Hewaa diraw, Kiristtoosa timirttiyaa biro doommiyaawa aggiide, wozanaama asaa timirttew sinthaw boytte; koyro nuuni tamaaranaw koshshiyaa timirttiyaa wodhdhii eqqiide tamaaranaw nuussi bessenna; he timirttii aye gooppe, maaddenna oosuwaappe simmiyaawaa, Xoossaa ammaniyaawaa, xinqqatatuwaabaa,
kushiyaa wothuwaabaa, hayquwaappe dendduwaabaanne medhinaa pirddaabaa.
Xoossay oothite gooppe, hewaa nuuni oothana.

Ayissi gooppe, ittoodekka poo7uu poo7eeddawanttanne saluwaa imuwaa baari be7eeddawantta, qassi Geeshsha Ayyaanaakka shaakki akkeeddawanttanne Xoossaa qaalay lo77a gideeddawaa sisi ereeddawantta, sinthaappe yaana sa7aa wolqqaakka bochchi xeelleeddawantta,

hewaappe guyye simmiide kaddeeddawaantta nagaraappe laa7enthuwa zaaranawe danddayettenna. Ayissi gooppe, hewanttu Xoossaa Na7aa masqqaliyaa bolla misimaariyan dhishiide kaqqiyaawanttanne asa sinthan kawushshiyaawanttu mala.
Ubba wode bukkiyaa iraa ushina, gosheedda uraa go77iyaa kathaa mokkiyaa biittaa Xoossay anjjee.
Shin buluwaanne buuzzuwaa mokkooppe, aynne go77enna; sheqaw shiiqi utteedda. Qassi wurssethaan guudettana.
Shin nu siiqatoo, nuuni hawaadan haasayiyaawaa gidooppenne, hinttenttu atotethaw gidiyaa lo77obay hinttenttussi de7iyaawaa ereetto.
Ayissi gooppe, hinttenttu ootheedda oosuwaanne qassi ammaniyaawantta maaddeeddawaaninne ha77ikka maaddiyaawan Xoossaa siiqeedda siiquwaa Xoossay doganaw makkala gidenna.
Hinttenttu huuphiyaan huuphiyaan demmana giide, hidootaan naagi utteedda kumentha tumatethaa wurssethay gakkanaw, kasewaadan minissiide oothana mala amotteetto.
Xoossay immana geeddawa ammanuwaaninne genccan laattiyawanttu mala hinttenttu gidanawaa nuuni koyyiyaawaappe attin, azalla gidanawaa koyyokko.
Xoossay Immeedda Hidootay Sidhissennawaa
Xoossay Abraahaamoo immana giide caaqqeedda wode, bareppe aadhdhiyaa wolqqaamay baynna diraw, bare huuphiyan caaqqeedda.
Xoossay A,
yaagiide caaqqeedda.
Hewaadankka, Abraahaamo gencci naagiide, Xoossay immana geeddawa akeedda.
Ayissi gooppe, asay bareppe dhoqqiyaa uraan caaqqee; qassi he caaquu palumiyaa ubbaakka te77ee.
Hewaa diraw, Xoossay bare immana geeddawa laattanawanttoo bare qofaa ubbaakka laammennawaa geeshshi odanaw loythi koyyiide, hewe tuma gideeddawoo caaqqeedda.
Xoossay worddotanaw danddayenna ha laa77u laamettenna yewatuwan, I immana geedda nu sinthan de7iyaawaa oyqqanaw aakko baqateedda nuussi wolqqaama menthethu de7ee.

Ha nuuni demmana giide nashechchaan naagi utteeddawe, nu shemppoo markkabiyaa oyqqiyaa qaaxxenna birataa mala; he nuuni demmana giide, nashechchaan naagi utteeddawe eretteedda mino gidiide, gaariiduwaa
giddo geeshshasaa gelee.
Qassi Yesuusi Malkki-Xedeqa sunthatethaadan, medhinaw qeesatuwaa ubbatuwaa kaappuwaa gidiide, nu gishshataw nuuppe kasetiide, he sa7aa geleedda.

footnotes.text: -2 Xinqqatatuwaabaa: Meechchatuwabaa giyaawaa gidiide geeshshatethaabaa Griiken dumma dumma wogaa gidiyaawaa bessee.

gaariduwaa: Hawe dunkkaaniyaa gidduwan goynaw maaddiyaawaa. Hewekka “Geeshshasaa” geetetteeddawaappe “Geeshshaappe Geeshshasaa” shaakkanaw go77iyaawaa gidiide qeesatuwaa kaappo xalalay gelanaw danddayiyaasaa.
